## Problem / Motivation

What biological or computational problem does this feature address?
Is your request related to a limitation you encountered?

## Proposed Solution

Describe the feature you would like. Be as specific as possible about
inputs, outputs, and expected behaviour.

## Alternatives Considered

Have you tried any workarounds or alternative tools? Why are they insufficient?

## Relevant References

Links to papers, tools, or databases that implement similar functionality
(if applicable).

## Additional Context

Any other context, mockups, or examples that would help explain the request.
